entities.name: Mychailo of Chernigiv
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mikhail Vsevolodovich, known as Michael or Michael of Chernigov, was Grand Prince of Kiev ; he was also Prince of Pereyaslavl (1206), Novgorod-Seversk (1219–1226), Chernigov, Novgorod, and Galicia (1235–1236). He was canonized as a saint in the Christian Church.
